items.headline: Aston Martin uncover celebratory livery tweak for US Grand Prix | RacingNews365

sources.evidence_excerpt: Article To news overview Aston Martin will race with a one-off livery at the United States Grand Prix to celebrate five years of partnership with Cognizant, the team has announced.
evidence_excerpts: Article To news overview Aston Martin will race with a one-off livery at the United States Grand Prix to celebrate five years of partnership with Cognizant, the team has announced.
The design marks a relationship that began in 2021, when Cognizant joined Aston Martin as the marque returned to the F1 grid.
The livery will take to the race track at the Circuit of the Americas this weekend, and will celebrate the partnership between the two outfits across the last handful of years.

sources.evidence_excerpt: Throwback To news overview © XPBimages Eleven years to the day after securing his only F1 drivers' championship, Kimi Raikkonen marked 21 October with another slice of history, winning the 2018 United
evidence_excerpts: Throwback To news overview © XPBimages Eleven years to the day after securing his only F1 drivers' championship, Kimi Raikkonen marked 21 October with another slice of history, winning the 2018 United
In doing so, he became the oldest grand prix winner since Nigel Mansell in 1994 and the record holder for the longest gap between F1 victories.
The Finn, then 39 years old, had not stood on the top step since the 2013 Australian Grand Prix, a run of 114 races without a win.
